description: It's crazy how much the situation in Cuba encapsulates so much of the Trump Administration's ethos. For those just tuning in, at the beginning of this year, the United States effectively imposed a blockade on the oil that has driven Cuba for decades.Point 1 - another case of the U.S. bullying a small, basically helpless nation.
